source_document: Rank Boost Email System, Complete Master v2
copy_standard: Each offer is a targeted test intended to improve organic visibility.
Search outcomes and timing vary by keyword, market, competition, and website and are not promised.
Past examples are from client campaigns and do not predict future results.
AI recommendations are separate from organic search and are not promised.
Opportunity math is illustrative and based on stated assumptions, not promised revenue.

emails.subject: You left something behind
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

Your scan confirmed that {{ subscriber.domain | default: "your website" }} qualifies for Rank Boost. You have not booked your free boost call yet.

We found {{ subscriber.top_keyword | default: "your qualifying keyword" }} at position {{ subscriber.top_position | default: "the position shown in your scan" }}.

{% if subscriber.opp_value != blank %}

At number one, our model estimates {{ subscriber.opp_value }}/month in potential case value for that keyword alone. Your results table shows the estimated increase from your current position.

This is an estimate based on search volume and conversion assumptions, not guaranteed revenue.

{% endif %}

Book your 30-minute call and we will walk through your keyword opportunity and plan your free boost. No payment required. No contract, site access, or logins needed.

Book your free boost call, or reply with your questions.

Bilal

emails.subject: {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "Hey" }}, a transparent look at the opportunity
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

Here is an illustrative model for {{ subscriber.top_keyword | default: "your keyword" }}: {{ subscriber.top_volume | default: "the recorded" }} monthly searches, a 35% click-through assumption at position one, a 10% inquiry assumption, a one-in-five close assumption, and {{ subscriber.case_value | default: "an estimated case value" }}.

Under those assumptions, the model shows {{ subscriber.opp_clicks | default: "estimated" }} visits, {{ subscriber.opp_leads | default: "estimated" }} inquiries, and roughly {{ subscriber.opp_value | default: "an estimated opportunity" }} monthly. It is not promised revenue, and your actual conversion and intake results may differ.

We can review the assumptions on a free 30-minute call. Book the call.

Bilal

emails.subject: What this can and cannot say about AI search
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

Organic visibility and AI recommendations are related topics, but they are separate systems. A targeted organic test for {{ subscriber.top_keyword | default: "your keyword" }} is not an AI-placement offer, and no AI recommendation is promised.

One client shared an experience with ChatGPT during a broader campaign: view the anonymized email. That example does not predict future results.

If AI visibility matters to your law firm, we can explain the distinction on a free 30-minute call. Choose a time.

Bilal

emails.html_body:

Here is one documented ranking example: view the result image. It is evidence from a client campaign, not a forecast for {{ subscriber.domain | default: "your website" }}.

The free call is where we assess whether a targeted visibility test may fit. No card, contract, or site access is required. Book your call.

Bilal

Bilal

emails.subject: The straight version of the offer
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

For qualified law firms, the offer is a free targeted test intended to improve organic visibility for an approved keyword. We qualify first, agree on a review window, and compare the before-and-after.

No credit card, contract, website access, or logins are required for the test. We do not promise a specific position, duration, traffic level, call volume, or revenue outcome.

I monitor replies personally. Reply with your question, or book a free 30-minute call.

Bilal

emails.subject: A measured test, not a ranking promise
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

The test is designed for law-firm keywords already appearing around positions 11 through 50. Its purpose is to measure whether a targeted visibility push changes the organic result for an agreed keyword.

Search engines control rankings. Results and timing vary, and no page-one placement or fixed hold period is promised. If the keyword is not suitable, we say so before proceeding.

There is no card, contract, or site access. Book a free 30-minute call to review fit.

Bilal

emails.subject: A careful answer about risk
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

It is sensible to ask how a visibility test is operated. The test does not require access to your site, logins, analytics, or publishing tools, and it does not change your website copy.

Search-platform policies and outcomes are controlled by the platforms, so no safety or enforcement outcome is promised. We explain the scope before launch and leave the decision with your firm.

For a law-firm-specific review, book the free 30-minute call. Replies are monitored.

Bilal

emails.subject: Why the keyword matters
emails.html_body:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

A commercially relevant search can be more useful to assess than a broad informational term, which is why we start with {{ subscriber.top_keyword | default: "your keyword" }} and the supporting terms from your scan.

A ranking change alone does not create clients. Your website, intake, responsiveness, market, and the searcher all affect what follows. The test is intended to improve visibility and help you evaluate those variables, not promise calls or cases.

We can review the keyword on a free call. Book a time.

Bilal

Organic rankings can fluctuate for many reasons. A before-and-after comparison provides a clearer discussion than a dashboard claim, while still recognizing that results vary.

To talk through the measurement plan for your law firm, book the free call.

Bilal
